from PIL import Image
im = Image.open('mock.png').convert('RGB')
w, h = im.size

# Find card bounding box (card is white inside #f3f4f6 bg)
# Let's find pixels where r > 250, g > 250, b > 250
card_pixels = []
for y in range(h):
    for x in range(w):
        r, g, b = im.getpixel((x, y))
        # card is bounded within top area where bg is #f3f4f6
        if y < 400 and (r > 250 and g > 250 and b > 250):
            card_pixels.append((x, y))

min_x = min(p[0] for p in card_pixels)
max_x = max(p[0] for p in card_pixels)
min_y = min(p[1] for p in card_pixels)
max_y = max(p[1] for p in card_pixels)
print(f'Card bounds: x in [{min_x}, {max_x}], y in [{min_y}, {max_y}]')
print(f'Card width: {max_x - min_x + 1}, height: {max_y - min_y + 1}')

# Check green circle
green_pixels = [ (x, y) for y in range(h) for x in range(w) if im.getpixel((x, y))[1] > 180 and im.getpixel((x, y))[0] < 160 ]
gx = [p[0] for p in green_pixels]
gy = [p[1] for p in green_pixels]
print(f'Green circle: x in [{min(gx)}, {max(gx)}], y in [{min(gy)}, {max(gy)}], diameter approx {max(gx)-min(gx)+1}')

# Check inputs and button
btn_pixels = [ (x, y) for y in range(h) for x in range(w) if im.getpixel((x, y))[0] < 30 and im.getpixel((x, y))[1] < 30 and im.getpixel((x, y))[2] < 45 and y > 280 and y < 350 ]
bx = [p[0] for p in btn_pixels]
by = [p[1] for p in btn_pixels]
print(f'Button bounds: x in [{min(bx)}, {max(bx)}], y in [{min(by)}, {max(by)}], size: {max(bx)-min(bx)+1}x{max(by)-min(by)+1}')
"
